title: Over 61,000 Form-7 applications filed by election officials in Karnataka, none cites reason
shows: It counts 61,059 Form 7 applications in Karnataka filed by registration officers themselves, none giving a reason, from the Commission's Form 10 records, and finds that more than 60,800 of them came after claims closed on 23 September. Officers said the system generated the forms with their digital signatures when electors sent notices could not be reached. Every elector the paper checked had already been deleted, and in at least 26 constituencies officers filed more objections than voters or third parties did.
quote: With no reason recorded, neither the voter nor anyone examining the electoral roll can establish why a particular name was marked for deletion or verify whether the removal was justified.

title: On last day of SIR camps in Delhi, BLOs wait, go door to door
shows: It visits the special enrolment camps in Chilla, New Moti Bagh and Sarai Kale Khan on their last day, where booth level officers received few or no Form 6 applications and spent the day on notices and door to door visits. It sets this against about 47.5 lakh electors left off Delhi's draft of 31 August and about 4.7 lakh Form 6 applications so far, and follows a first time applicant held up at the declaration about his parents' entry in the last intensive revision.
quote: Even on the last day of the Election Commission's special camps being held across Delhi to enrol voters left out of the rolls in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR), BLOs mostly found themselves waiting for residents.

title: Irregularities in Voter Lists Like Pilibhit Could Alter UP's Electoral Outcome. Here's Why
shows: It sets the Samajwadi Party's list of 100 constituencies where the party alleges duplicate entries against the 2022 Assembly results, and finds that 43 of them were seats the party narrowly won or lost. It counts 124 seats won by fewer than 10,000 votes in 2022 and 53 by fewer than 5,000, beside the 10,470 entries the Chief Electoral Officer's inquiry found in Pilibhit, a seat the BJP won by 6,970 votes.
quote: Given the exceptionally narrow margins between victory and defeat in Uttar Pradesh, a Pilibhit-like numerical fluctuation could alter the electoral outcome of a tightly contested constituency.

title: Election Commission’s SIR Damage Control
shows: It goes through the measures the Commission announced from 26 September, among them the review of ECINET, the Form 6 declaration in the period outside the SIR, the cap on Form 7 applications of 9 October, and the Special Summary Revision with draft and final rolls in PDF for parties at no cost. It sets them beside the two Election Commissioners' objections and the Cabinet Secretariat's RTI reply, with comments from former Chief Election Commissioner O.P. Rawat, Maj Gen Anil Verma (Retd) of ADR and a co-founder of Voter Adhikar Manch.
